---
title: "Paper note · AgentBench"
---

**Source** [@liu2024agentbench]. The citation points to arXiv revision 3.

## Question and method

How reliably can language models complete tasks as agents across different interactive environments? The authors use eight environments with task-specific observations and action interfaces, and evaluate complete trajectories.

## Evidence and limits

The paper analyzes failures such as invalid formatting, invalid actions, and turn-limit exhaustion. These categories can guide a diagnosis, and their observed frequency depends on the benchmark's environment, agent adapter, and turn limit. Repeated runs under a changed adapter may therefore answer a different evaluation question.

## Follow-up

Keep the model, task set, and turn budget fixed. Compare two representations of the same tool schema. Check whether lower invalid-action rates correspond to improved terminal success.
